# FR-212a — Pin npx tools + wrap SKILLS behind an engine flag

**Parent Brief:** FR-212 · **Type:** Feature · **Priority:** P1-High · **Effort:** M-Medium
**Plan:** `~/.igris/projects/igris-ai/plans/FR-212-plan.md` §Child A (file-level detail there)

## Goal
`igris add/remove skill` + the skills pass of `igris harness compile` shell out to `npx skills` behind an `IGRIS_SKILLS_ENGINE` flag (**default `custom`**), with the custom `project_skills` still the default until the smoke gate (FR-212d) flips it. Delegate stands up ALONGSIDE custom — the #832 de-risk (FR-202 M1 reverted skills→npx; don't trust the README over a live probe).

## Scope (see plan §Child A)
- `cli/package.json` — add `skills` (vercel-labs) + `add-mcp` (neon-solutions) as **PINNED exact-version** runtime deps (both A+B need them; pin once here). Bundle local binaries in `dist/` so invocation resolves a LOCAL binary, never a runtime `npx` fetch.
- CREATE `cli/src/lib/skills-delegate.ts` — `projectSkillsViaTool({source,harnesses,global,mode})` + `unprojectSkillsViaTool(name)` resolving the LOCAL `skills` binary (`require.resolve`/`node_modules/.bin`, NEVER bare `npx`); `skills add <abs-path> -g` (all detected, symlink) + `skills remove`; the `IGRIS_SKILLS_ENGINE` resolver (`delegate`|`custom`, default `custom`). NO custom-engine fallback.
- MODIFY `core/scripts/cli-adapters/compile_harnesses.sh` `project_skills()` + `check_harness_drift.sh` `verify_skills` — flag-gated shell-out (mirror how `project_mcp`/`project_hook` already shell to the CLI); keep the custom loop intact behind the flag. **TD-096 mirror BOTH (`cp` repo→runtime + `bash core/scripts/verify_mirror.sh` verbatim MATCH).**
- MODIFY `cli/src/verbs/remove.ts` — skill un-projection routes to `unprojectSkillsViaTool` under delegate; custom `deleteLink` path stays behind the flag.
- CREATE `cli/src/__tests__/skills-delegate.test.ts` — argv builder resolves a LOCAL binary (assert no bare `npx`), `${VAR}`/no-secret-leak, verdict parser; spy the spawn (never spawn for real).

## Constraints
WRAP, not replace (verb signatures + UX unchanged) · pinned exact deps + local binary + no runtime fetch + no custom fallback · TD-096 mirror every `core/` edit · flag defaults to `custom` (prod behavior unchanged until FR-212d).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Both tools pinned (no `^`) + bundled; local-binary invocation (no bare `npx`) — unit-asserted.
- [ ] `IGRIS_SKILLS_ENGINE=delegate` routes skills add/remove + the compile skills-pass to `npx skills`; default `custom` path unchanged.
- [ ] `compile_harnesses.sh` + `check_harness_drift.sh` flag-gated; TD-096 mirror MATCH quoted.
- [ ] Existing verb-signature tests pass UNCHANGED (the wrap proof).
- [ ] New `skills-delegate.test.ts` green; full cli vitest + bats baselines green.

closes #FR-212a
